discovery.description: We dive deep into your requirements, understanding your business goals, target users, and technical constraints. This phase includes stakeholder interviews, market analysis, and technical feasibility assessment.

design.title: Design
design.description: Our design team creates intuitive interfaces and user experiences. We iterate through wireframes, prototypes, and visual designs until every interaction feels natural and every pixel is intentional.

development.title: Development
development.description: Our engineers write clean, tested, and maintainable code. We work in agile sprints with regular demos, ensuring you're always in the loop and can provide feedback as we build.
